Change tcp_init_transfer() to only initialize congestion control if it
has not been initialized already.
With this new approach
column2: we can arrange things so that if the EBPF code

column1: sets the congestion control by calling setsockopt(TCP_CONGESTION) then
tcp_init_transfer() will not re-initialize the CC module.
This is an approach that has the following beneficial properties:
(1) This allows CC module customizations made by the EBPF called in
tcp_init_transfer() to persist
column2: and not be wiped out by a later

column1: call to tcp_init_congestion_control() in tcp_init_transfer().
(2) Does not flip the order of EBPF and CC init
for existing code upstream that depends on the current order.
(3) Does not cause 2 initializations for for CC in the case where the
EBPF called in tcp_init_transfer() wants to set the CC to a new CC
algorithm.
(4) Allows follow-on simplifications to the code in net/core/filter.c
and net/ipv4/tcp_cong.c
column2: which currently both have some complexity

column1: to special-case CC initialization to avoid double CC
initialization if EBPF sets the CC.
